name: typesafe-jev-model-routing
description:
Routes AI/LLM requests to different models using TypeSafe AI's Jev System One model.
Jev chooses the user-defined routing rule (each with a name and context description) that best fits each incoming request, and the request is routed to that rule's model.
Effective for routing by topic, intent, or complexity (e.g., sending complex reasoning to a larger model and casual chat to a smaller one).
When Jev is unavailable or not confident enough, requests fall back to a configurable default model.

Note: This policy requires a TypeSafe AI API key.
Routes can optionally select an additional provider, with a configurable default provider for fallback.
